text:
marta: Drafting the release note + internal blurb for tonight's EU canary. Need ops + legal quick ACK before I queue the blast.

marta: RN draft: "KV cache warmup reduces cold-start token latency ~30% (p95). Model pinned to v2.1.3 for canary; automatic fallback to v2.0.9 on overload. SDK auth-header change is opt-in behind a feature flag. Private EU customers: data processed in-region per residency settings."

josh: RN bullets to include: warmup metrics (warmup_ms, warmup_hits), link to perf dashboard, SDK PR link, rollback criteria.

kai: Ops proposal: start canary at 5% traffic for 10m, ramp to 20% if green. Rollback triggers: error rate >1.5% for 5m OR p95 latency >1500ms for 3m. I'll run the ramp and monitor.

lia: Legal: wording looks fine, please include the in-region phrase. I'll sign off once that's included.

marta: Deploy command we'll run:
```
/deploy canary eu-1 --pin model:v2.1.3 --tag rn-2026-04-02-x --traffic 5% --notes "kv-warmup, sdk-flag"
```
Alerts -> canary-alerts@pager + #infra.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled canary rn-2026-04-02-x for eu-1 at 2026-04-02T00:30:00Z; queued by marta. Reply with "ACK" to confirm standby.

josh: ACK  infra dashboards + alerts configured. Will pin perf panels.

kai: SGTM. I'll ramp at +10m if metrics stable and add canary-checklist tag.

marta: One-line internal blurb suggestion (30m prior): "Canary rn-2026-04-02-x: model v2.1.3 -> 5% EU, ramp to 20% if healthy. Oncall: infra/josh, eng/kai. Rollback if >1.5% errors or p95 >1500ms."

lia: :thumbsup: legal signed off on the wording.

marta: Thanks all  I'll update the RN doc, queue the internal announce, and hit deploy-bot 30m prior. :rocket:
